claims.title: Normalization and finite rational refinement additivity uniquely force local mass mu(w)=w on rational weights
claims.scope: local weight-only mass rules on Q intersect [0,1] with mu(1)=1 and additivity over every finite rational partition
assumptions: mass depends only on the local rational probability weight
nonclaims: measures depending on additional physical or causal structure are outside this characterization

claims.title: Equal r-way cloning scales integer-power escort score w^gamma by r^(1-gamma)
claims.scope: positive rational component weight, integer gamma>=0, and r>=2 equal positive clones
assumptions: escort score is defined as w^gamma with gamma=0 assigning unit score to positive weights
nonclaims: escort scores are examples rather than a preferred anthropic measure

claims.title: Within the nonnegative integer-power escort family, only gamma one is invariant under every equal positive clone refinement
claims.scope: integer gamma>=0 and arbitrary clone count r>=2
assumptions: invariance means total unnormalized local score is unchanged by equal cloning
nonclaims: the theorem does not classify all possible nonlocal measures

claims.title: Twenty-way refinement of one half-mass category yields escort category masses 20/21, 1/2, and 1/21 at powers zero, one, and two
claims.scope: two equal initial category weights with only the simulated category refined into twenty equal positive clones
assumptions: escort category probabilities are normalized from local power scores
nonclaims: the three escort powers are illustrative

claims.title: Bounded exact rational refinement-measure audit
claims.scope: all rational weights with denominators through twenty, clone counts through fifty, escort powers zero through three, and invalid-weight rejection
assumptions: all calculations use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded checks are not empirical evidence for simulation
